integrity_triggers.condition: parent pin, selected relation, baseline or certificate hash mismatch
source/wheel/environment/protocol identity differs from chain plan
checkpoint bytes, dependency binding or stage identity mismatch
critical science projection or selected relation does not replay byte-identically
release verification or catalog rebuild/accounting fails
authority promotion, forbidden claim or claim record requested
path escape, live conflicting lock or unaudited lock recovery

limit_rule: After producing an eligible parent at max_target_level, stop normally with COMPLETE_LIMIT_REACHED; do not derive another packet.
non_triggers: a higher bounded maximum parent count
changes in inclusion height or width
continued presence of an inherited review escalation already recorded in the parent

operational_triggers.condition: predicted or actual attempts exceed frozen max_level_attempts
exact unique candidates exceed frozen max_unique_candidates
level wall time exceeds frozen max_level_wall_seconds
chain wall time exceeds frozen max_total_wall_seconds

scientific_triggers.condition: a parent-persistent tracked relation has zero current support or is absent
classification observed_or_new nonempty or Spectroscope emits an unregistered recognition token
current escalation set contains an item not already present in parent escalation set
parent max count > 1 and current selected max parent count <= 1
for every distinct observed exact parent-fiber pair, both intersection and union are observed
predicate classifier is incomplete, contradictory or returns an unregistered state
equal frozen shallow descriptors show distinct exact one-step futures in a registered probe
